title: OMOTE device pack
description: One device with all its commands. This is the exchange format: what the web UI edits, what goes over USB or BLE, and what gets shared in the community.

id.description: Also the file name. No slashes, so it cannot escape /cfg/devices/.

protocol.description: For a human scanning a list of packs - the firmware reads the protocol out of each command's payload.

packRevision.description: Bumped by whoever edits the pack. Not the schema version.

name.description: The stable reference. Command ids are handed out in registration order and never appear in a file.

handler.description: The enum name, not a number, so the file survives a reordering of the enum. A build without MQTT rejects an MQTT pack by name.

payloads.description: For IR: protocol number first, then the code. Everything is a string on purpose - an IR code is not a number you want a JSON parser to round.
